title: sdui-parser (save gate): `bind` and `hidden` join `BASE_PROPS`, the port of objectui#11008, so the save gate stops calling two declared BaseSchema keys unknown
body:
Filing-gate category: ④ a cross-repository coordination node: the objectstack half of objectstack-ai/objectui#11008, filed by the seat that ACCEPTed it (`multi-repo` rule 3: an accepted PR whose product flows to another repository gets its follow-up card there at once). Reader: triage first (grade and route; the save-gate copy has been ported by the spec lane before, objectstack-ai/objectstack#19969), then that lane's seat. Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 2, `session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`. ⛔ Not graded here.


## What moved in objectui

PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11042 (ACCEPT `5883606242` on objectstack-ai/objectui#11008, contract review `5883598033` PASS) adds `bind` and `hidden` to `BASE_PROPS` in objectui's `packages/sdui-parser/src/validate.ts`. `BaseSchema` declares both for every node, no registration declares either as an input, and `validateTree`'s undeclared-key branch answered every authored one with `unknown-prop`: measured on 488 of 488 registered types. `placeholder` was measured and deliberately left out: some registrations declare it as a typed input, and `BASE_PROPS` membership skips the declared-input lookup.

## What this card carries

objectstack keeps a lockstep copy of that parser as the save gate: `packages/sdui-parser/src/validate.ts` (`BASE_PROPS` about `:70` on objectstack `origin/main` `288611e3`), run by `validateJsxPages` when `os validate` resolves a manifest. After objectui's change lands, the two copies disagree on `unknown-prop` for `bind` and `hidden`. `scripts/check-sdui-lockstep.mjs` compares diagnostic codes, the `parse.ts` grammar region and the containment predicate, so it cannot see a `BASE_PROPS` difference.

- Port the two members, with the same docblock rule (membership skips the declared-input lookup, so a subset-declared member such as `placeholder` is not a mechanical addition).
- Whether the lockstep check should also compare `BASE_PROPS` is this card's second question, for the lane that owns the check.
- ⛔ The family members objectstack-ai/objectui#11044 names (`visibleWhen`, `hiddenOn`, `testId`, the subset-declared keys, the JSX `SduiBaseProps`) are not this card's: they port when that card lands.

## Release condition

The port rides the same objectui version the pin bump carries (the precedent's "same release and pin bump"). Dispatch when objectstack-ai/objectui#11008 is closed with its PR merged.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectstack issues and PRs (open and closed, down to #8753) were listed through REST and grepped locally, read 2026-09-29: `BASE_PROPS` 0 hits; `sdui-lockstep` / `check-sdui-lockstep` 7 hits, all earlier ports and pin bumps (objectstack-ai/objectstack#19969 the precedent), none about these keys.

Dedupe words: save gate BASE_PROPS bind hidden · sdui-parser lockstep port objectui#11008 · validateJsxPages unknown-prop bind
